title: A support desk flow sorts the inbox, drafts replies for the Owner, and never sends on its own
description: Second new department in the master plan (P3, 2026-11-11), gated by Daniel: work starts only when he says go. A new shipped flow, flows/support-desk: off, L1, a dollar cap, and no action class that sends. A cycle reads messages dropped in $FW_HOME/flows/support-desk/inbox/ (one JSON each: id, from, subject, text, received_at), sorts each with a pure triage (billing words win over bug words, which win over feature words; obvious junk is spam; the rest are questions), and drafts one reply per message that is not spam into the flow's drafts with status waiting_for_owner, its category and the message id it answers. A message that already has a draft gets no second one. Nothing is written to the outbox, and the dial stops at Copilot: Autopilot is refused for this flow. Pulling the inbox from Gmail (draft only, never send) is a later row. Wave 5 of the master plan v2.
acceptance: flows/support-desk ships off, L1, capped and with no *_external action class
triage sorts billing, bug, feature, question and spam the same way every time, billing first
A run drafts 4 replies for 5 messages (none for spam), all waiting for the Owner, writes nothing to the outbox, does not draft twice, and Autopilot is refused with 400
